verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local API bundled with the desktop app. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi-v2.yaml) with full schemas and error responses is published on the developer portal, alongside a versioned API reference and changelog, a headless CLI server for automation, and an official MCP server for AI assistants. The OpenAPI probe 404s were on doc.anytype.io, not on the developer portal where the spec actually lives. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a remote (non-localhost) API endpoint, a written deprecation policy, and an interactive try-it console.
